observations: Industrial sewing machine mounted on a white table with a ruler edge.
Brand 'TWO LION' is printed on the machine head and the table surface.
The machine head features a digital control panel and a red adjustment dial.
A red foot pedal is visible under the table.
A piece of paper in the foreground shows the text 'TL93'.
The machine appears to be a direct-drive model as no external belt is visible connecting to a motor under the table.

claims.evidence: The lack of a visible belt suggests direct drive, but internal motor configuration is not shown.
The photo shows a standard H-leg stand; 'double' is not a standard technical term verified by the image.
Internal cooling fans cannot be seen from external photos.

risks.risk: Electronic control board or integrated motor failure.
risks.proof: Video of the machine powered on, navigating the digital menu, and sewing.

risks.risk: Mechanical timing issues or damaged needle bar.
risks.proof: Video of the machine sewing through at least four layers of denim or heavy fabric.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing a test strip.
Photo of the manufacturer's plate on the back or side of the machine head.
Photo of the underside of the table to see the wiring and any auxiliary components.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model (TL93). It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit until operational proof is provided.
